Package index

Main function

Acute and chronic loads and the ACWR for one or several athletes, with one or more methods.

ACWR()
Acute Chronic Workload Ratio

Calculation methods

One athlete: exponentially weighted moving average (Williams et al., 2017) and coupled and uncoupled rolling averages (Windt & Gabbett, 2019), on a daily calendar.

EWMA()
Exponentially Weighted Moving Average
RAC()
Rolling Average Coupled
RAU()
Rolling Average Uncoupled

Plotting

Training load and ACWR per day, drawn with d3.js.

plot_ACWR()
ACWR plots using d3.js

Datasets

Simulated training loads of three athletes.

training_load
Training load dataframe
training_load_rest
Training load dataframe with rest days
